name: persona-extract
summary: The Chapter 13 persona-linkage engine: parse personas, extract hard-identifier / stylometric / behavioural links, and fuse them into operator clusters with confidence and framing flags — graded by the persona scorer. Reuses the Ch10 union-find.

modules.identifiers.py: Parses persona profiles to records and finds hard links (shared signed key, shared wallet); flags a displayed-but-not-signed key as possible framing rather than a link.
modules.stylometry.py: Fingerprints writing voice (function words + char trigrams) and scores similarity; a soft signal that re-links an operator who rotated keys but kept its register.
modules.behavior.py: Behavioural links: activity-rhythm histogram overlap, leet handle-transformation equality, and repeated Ch12 tactic sequence.
modules.fuse.py: Fuses all signals under one rule (hard dominates, soft must corroborate, displayed-only never merges), clusters personas into operators with the Ch10 union-find, and assigns high/medium confidence.
modules.pipeline.py: Runs the whole linkage (naive vs full); --selftest grades itself with the persona scorer.

corpus: corpus/ — the persona lab: 8 personas across 4 operators. Alpha (market vendor + 2 leak brands + forum handle, hard-linked by reused key+wallet with soft corroboration), Bravo (rotated key AND wallet, soft-only re-link), Charlie (borrowed-key frame), Delta (handle look-alike). All watermarked synthetic.
reuses: ../dedup/cluster.py (_UF union-find). Echoes Ch11 vendors (NightHawk, SaltMine, Mimic's borrowed key) and Ch12 operator tells (key F19B7A0C4E82D5613FA0 + wallet + tactic sequences).
consumed_by: ../persona-scorer/scorer.py (link recall/precision, false merges, operator count, confidence calibration, framing flagged)
guardrail: Links pseudonym to pseudonym only. It clusters personas into an operator with a confidence; it does NOT take the last step from persona to a real-world person, which is a legal/law-enforcement process out of scope by design.
